action: As the district's notice of 17 November asks, patients with questions about appointments should phone the hospital first. General advice: other hospitals should confirm they can run emergency care without IT.
exec: An attack on hospital IT interrupted emergency care, showing the patient-safety stakes of IT resilience.
impact: Emergency room unavailable from 15 November; the district says it took patients again from 17 November and operating theatres were fully functional again on 18 November.
plain: A cyberattack on a district hospital in Greiz, Germany, found on November 15, shut its emergency room. The district says the emergency room took patients again from November 17 and operating theatres worked fully again by November 18.

sources.name: Landratsamt Greiz: Notaufnahme nimmt wieder Patienten auf
Landratsamt Greiz: Krankenhaus holt Operationstermine nach

summary: The Greiz district says a cyberattack on its hospital, discovered on November 15, made the emergency room unavailable; state criminal police and prosecutors were called in. Kommunal.de reports the district called it an extortion attempt; on November 17 the district said it could not comment on any demands during the investigation. The district says the emergency room took patients again from November 17 and, on November 18, that operating theatres were fully functional again.
title: Cyberattack closes emergency room at Greiz-Ronneburg hospital in Germany

validation.note: Follow-up 2026-11-23: read the district's news list and its notices of 17 Nov (ER admitting patients again; no statements on the attack or any demands while investigations continue) and 18 Nov (operating theatres fully functional again, postponed operations largely caught up); no later notice on the list, no attribution, nothing on patient data. Follow-up 2026-11-21: re-read Landkreis Greiz notice (15 Nov; no later update; LKA and prosecutor called in) and Security Affairs (17 Nov; extortion attempt per spokesperson Uwe Mueller, hospital not commenting on patient data, prosecutor and LKA investigating, per MDR police investigating a suspect, no group named). Earlier: Read Landkreis Greiz (15 Nov, attack found ~9:00, ER unavailable), kommunal.de (17 Nov, extortion attempt per district, data unsettled), Freie Presse (17 Nov, ER taking patients), kma-online (16 Nov), pasqualepillitteri.it (loads now; police say unauthorized access, no data theft confirmed). Removed unsupported ransomware tag and "roughly two days".
